defect: The fix replaces the auto lambdas passed to std::thread with std::function to silence a TSAN report in concurrent_with_perf that the change itself documented as a false positive.
reason: The added test code has no real data race or other defect; the fix is a workaround for a tool false positive whose author did not know why it helps.

defect: After FindReadAheadSizeUpperBound the index iterator is re-seeked but its validity is never checked before index_iter_->value() is used, so an IO error during the re-seek leaves an invalid iterator and trips an assertion/crash (and the work is redone on the async second pass).
reason: The unchecked re-seek is in lines this change added, and the fix adds exactly the missing Valid() check plus an is_first_pass guard.

defect: The new test file puts everything including main() inside #ifndef ROCKSDB_LITE, so the ROCKSDB_LITE build of write_callback_test has no main and fails to link.
reason: The missing LITE main is in the file this change created; the fix adds the #else branch with a main.

defect: The fix widens the WinEnvThreads priority asserts from LOW to BOTTOM after a BOTTOM thread pool was added.
reason: When this change added GetBackgroundThreads, Env::Priority was {LOW, HIGH, TOTAL}, so its assert was correct; the asserts became wrong only when cc01985 (2017-08) introduced BOTTOM.

defect: The fix lets the engine create new backups when the most recent backup is corrupt by tracking latest_backup_id_ separately from a new latest_valid_backup_id_.
reason: Before this change latest_backup_id_ was already updated only from successfully loaded backups, so the corrupt-latest problem predates it; the change only reworked the loop to limit opened backups.

defect: The new test's sync-point dependency makes the background flush wait at FlushMemTableToOutputFile:BeforeInstallSV while holding the DB mutex, while the main thread needs that mutex for Put/TEST_SwitchMemtable, so the test deadlocks.
reason: The deadlocking dependency is in test lines this change added and the fix moves it to a sync point reached without the mutex; seeing it requires db_impl's locking.

defect: The change prints the size_t applyOptionForRecordIndex with PRIu64, which mismatches size_t where size_t is not uint64_t (Mac, 32-bit) and breaks -Wformat -Werror builds.
reason: The wrong specifier is in lines this change wrote and the fix replaces it with ROCKSDB_PRIszt; the size_t declaration is in the shown context.

defect: AddLogToBuffer advances p by vsnprintf's would-be length, so a long message moves p past limit and the terminating write overflows the buffer.
reason: This cleanup moved the code verbatim from util/env.cc, where the same overflow already existed.

defect: The fix only renames the test member lru_cache_ops_ to lru_cache_opts_.
reason: A pure rename with no behavioural effect is not a defect repair.

defect: The change adds the -d flag to the xcrun atos command line, which breaks symbolization of stack traces on Mac.
reason: The fix, by the same author and titled as fixing the Mac stack trace, removes exactly the flag this change slipped into an unrelated commit; the breakage depends on atos behaviour, not on code.

defect: The fix removes ChangeFilter's private argv_ member, which is unused in NDEBUG builds and triggers clang's unused-field warning on Mac.
reason: argv_ and its assert-only use predate this change, which only added explicit to the constructor.

defect: The new BitStream test reads bytes[kNumBytes+1] and bytes[64/8+1] from an array of size kNumBytes+1, an out-of-bounds read.
reason: The off-by-one indices are in test lines this change added and the fix corrects them.

defect: The fix makes toCppTickers map 0x38 back to NO_ITERATORS and NO_ITERATOR_CREATED/DELETED to 0x5F/0x60, matching toJavaTickerType after a138e351 restored NO_ITERATORS.
reason: At this change the C++ enum, the Java enum and both portal conversions were mutually consistent; the mismatch arose when a138e351 reordered the enum and updated only toJavaTickerType.

defect: The statistics dump tests if (FLAGS_simcache_size) instead of >= 0, so with the default -1 it dynamic_pointer_casts an ordinary LRU cache to SimCache and dereferences a null pointer.
reason: The wrong condition is in a line this change added and the fix changes it to >= 0, matching the constructor's check.

defect: operand_list_ holds Slices pointing into strings stored in a std::vector<std::string>; when copied_operands_ grows the strings move, leaving the Slices dangling.
reason: The vector-of-strings backing store is introduced by this change and the fix switches it to unique_ptr<string> elements.

defect: TryMerge tests std::max(dest_offset, dest_offset) instead of std::max(dest_offset, src_offset), so disjoint read requests are merged into huge reads.
reason: The typo is in the function this change added and the fix corrects exactly that operand.

defect: The new max_write_buffer_number part of DynamicMemtableOptions reuses one SleepingBackgroundTask after WakeUp/WaitUntilDone; should_sleep_ stays false, so later schedules do not block the compaction thread and the count assertions fail.
reason: The reuse is in lines this change added and the fix uses fresh tasks; seeing it needs the SleepingBackgroundTask implementation outside the diff.

defect: The new post-loop PartialMergeMulti call passes ikey.user_key, the loop variable that can hold the next user key or stale data, instead of orig_ikey.user_key.
reason: The call is in lines this change added and the fix switches to orig_ikey and scopes ikey inside the loop.

defect: GetL0ThresholdSpeedupCompaction returns the int64_t res from an int function by implicit narrowing, which breaks builds using -Wshorten-64-to-32 with -Werror.
reason: The narrowing return is in a line this change added and the fix makes the conversion explicit.

defect: The new CompactionReason enum is defined inside #ifndef ROCKSDB_LITE although code built in LITE mode uses it, so ROCKSDB_LITE fails to compile.
reason: The misplaced enum is in lines this change added and the fix moves it outside the guard; the LITE users are in other files.

defect: MinLevelToCompress returns void, so when no compression is supported the callers still Reopen, write to the null options.compression_per_level and use an uninitialized type.
reason: The helper and its callers were written by this change; the fix makes it return bool and skip the test.

defect: The new CollapseKey test hard-codes rocksdb::GetMergeOperandsOptions, which does not compile when ROCKSDB_NAMESPACE is set to another namespace.
reason: The hard-coded namespace is in a line this change added and the fix drops the qualifier.

defect: The fix avoids a use-after-free when a child thread using ThreadLocalPtr exits after the main thread has destroyed the static singletons.
reason: OnThreadExit already used the function-static Instance() and a static mutex before this change (the fix calls it a legacy bug); the change only moved the mutex into a function static.

defect: The rewritten PresetCompressionDict test (ten distinct random values, max_dict_bytes of four blocks, zstd training on a whole L0 file) lets the zstd-trained dictionary sometimes compress worse than the untrained one, so its strict size assertion fails intermittently.
reason: The test was disabled as flaky eight days after this change, and the fix reverts the dictionary size this change set and relaxes the comparison; flakiness from compression output is not visible in code.

defect: The new test passes a size_t* to Env::GetFileSize, which takes uint64_t*, so it does not compile where size_t and uint64_t differ (clang on OS X).
reason: The mismatched variable is in lines this change added and the fix uses uint64_t; the signature is in env.h.

defect: The new IntraL0Compaction test loops over i but checks level_to_files[0][0] instead of [0][i], so the second L0 file is never verified (the same commit's L0->L0 compaction also drops deletions, which the fix repairs elsewhere).
reason: The indexing bug is in test lines this change added and the fix corrects it.

defect: The new heap test uses std::mt19937 and uniform_int_distribution without including <random> and seeds the engine with an int64_t, which fails to compile on Mac.
reason: Both problems are in the file this change created and the fix adds the include and a cast.

defect: The fix raises the s390x GCC threshold for the 64-byte cache line from below 6 to below 7 because gcc 6.4 also mishandles 256-byte alignment.
reason: Before this change every GCC on s390x used 256, so gcc 6 was already broken; the change repaired older GCC and left gcc 6 as it was.

defect: The fix makes trivial moves add the file at c->output_level() instead of c->level() + 1.
reason: level() + 1 was correct when this change was made and existed before it; it became wrong when b118238 (D36669) let trivial moves skip levels, as the fix message says.

defect: In this file the fix strengthens DynamicLevelMaxBytesBaseInc to verify the values; the trivial-move-to-wrong-level bug itself lies in this commit's compaction.cc together with db_impl.cc.
reason: The test lines this change added contain no defect; the fix's edit of this file is a test strengthening.

defect: The change sets MultiScan use_async_io straight from the flag without checking that the file system supports async IO, hitting an assertion in the block-based table iterator.
reason: The unconditional assignment is the line this change added and the fix guards it with CheckFSFeatureSupport; the assertion is in another file.

defect: The fix removes a race in DBFlushTest.SyncFail between reading the version ref count and the background flush taking its ref in PickMemtables.
reason: This change only wrapped the already flaky test in #ifndef TRAVIS; the race predates it.

defect: The new IsSnapshotSupported iterates the ColumnFamilySet without the DB mutex, called from GetSnapshot before locking and from findEarliestVisibleSnapshot during unlocked compaction, causing segfaults.
reason: Both unlocked call sites were added by this change and the fix moves them under the mutex; the locking requirement is documented elsewhere.

defect: The fix makes DelayWrite record the stall time before returning TimedOut instead of returning from inside the wait loop.
reason: When this change added the early return only return bg_error_ followed the loop and the StopWatch still recorded on exit; the skipped stats code was added later by 9132e52.

defect: In this file the fix only changes the stall-time output to a human-readable format; the counter bug is the timeout early return skipping the new stats recording in db_impl.cc.
reason: The lines this change added to internal_stats.cc are correct; the defect lies in the same commit's db_impl.cc part, not in this file.

defect: The TamperWithDecompressionOutput callback allocates new char[size + 1] without initializing it and passes it on as block contents, so the test reads uninitialized memory (valgrind error).
reason: The uninitialized allocation is in the test this change added and the fix value-initializes it.

defect: PrintEnv prints the uint64 FLAGS_db_write_buffer_size with %lu, a -Wformat error on Mac where the type is unsigned long long.
reason: The format string is in a line this change added and the fix corrects it.

defect: The fix stops a read-only backup engine from deleting backups newer than the latest and adds logging, including reformatting the backup size log line.
reason: This change only switched two log format specifiers to PRIu64; the read-only deletion bug came from D28521 and the shared log line was merely reformatted.

defect: The fix makes GetLatestSequenceForKey return the newest sequence number and timestamp for keys with merge operands by recording them before the type switch.
reason: The s->seq overwrite causing the bug predates this change; the timestamp lines it added for deletions were correct and are only relocated by the fix.

defect: In this file the fix adds an assertion and a CompactionIntoMultipleFiles test for a CuckooTableBuilder::FileSize bug located in another file.
reason: The test lines this change added are not defective; the fix's edit here is a test addition.
